name: CED Central Ohio
old_description: We are regarded as one of the top electrical suppliers in the Columbus Ohio region. From Mansfield to Cincinnati and everywhere in-between. With locations in Columbus and Newark we are poised to help you grow your business.
about:
CED Central Ohio operates as a branch of Consolidated Electrical Distributors (CED), a national network with more than 700 locations across the United States. The company serves the Columbus, Ohio region from two facilities in Columbus and Newark, covering a service area that stretches from Mansfield to Cincinnati and includes Franklin, Licking, Delaware, Fairfield, and surrounding counties.

The branch stocks a broad line of residential, commercial, and industrial electrical products from manufacturers such as Square D (Schneider Electric), Southwire, Milwaukee Tool, Acuity Brands, Leviton, Sylvania, and Cooper Lighting Solutions. Beyond product distribution, it provides asset management solutions, customer project storage, switchgear quotations and project management, design-build services, lighting design and quotations, and a local delivery fleet.

Its customer base includes commercial electrical contractors, residential electrical contractors, multi-family developers, industrial facilities, utilities, and national accounts. The company positions itself as a full-line electrical supply partner for projects ranging from residential renovations to large-scale commercial and industrial installations.

CED Central Ohio emphasizes a policy of service, integrity, and reliability, citing its local inventory depth, dedicated sales team, and delivery capabilities as key differentiators in the Columbus market.
type_evidence: Consolidated Electrical Distributors is one of the largest electrical solutions distributor and product supplier in the country with over 700+ locations nationally.
